content.short: Theta is a purpose-built L1 blockchain for video, AI, and entertainment, featuring a decentralized edge cloud.
content.description:
Theta Network is a leading decentralized video delivery and AI computing platform, designed to provide a high-performance infrastructure for the global entertainment industry. The network utilizes a dual structure consisting of the Theta Blockchain for transaction settlement and the Theta Edge Network, a distributed web of nodes that provide GPU compute power for video transcoding, 3D rendering, and AI tasks. This approach significantly reduces the cost of content delivery while incentivizing participants to share their idle resources.

Powered by the THETA governance token and TFUEL utility token, the protocol features a robust framework for decentralized content ownership and monetization. Theta serves as a vital infrastructure layer for major media companies and independent creators, providing the tools needed to launch scalable Web3 applications. Through its commitment to technological innovation and ecosystem-wide collaboration, Theta Network is building the essential framework for a more efficient and secure digital future, where compute power and content delivery are globally accessible utilities.
content.meta: Theta Network provides a decentralized Layer 1 blockchain and edge cloud for video, AI, and entertainment.
